# World of Mystery (Worldofmys)

> An interactive 3D WebGL cartography experience mapping 2,000 folklore legends, mythical cryptids, sacred relics, and paranormal phenomena across Thailand and the world.

## Project Overview
- **Name**: World of Mystery
- **URL**: https://worldofmys.pages.dev
- **Core Technology**: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, MapLibre GL 3D Globe, Cloudflare D1 Database, Cloudflare Pages Edge Functions.
- **Dataset Size**: Exactly 2,000 verified folklore dossiers with multimedia archives (YouTube embeds, high-resolution imagery).

## Major Features
- **Interactive 3D Globe**: Spherical 3D celestial navigation with multi-tier cluster hierarchy (Macro, Regional, Local).
- **Paranormal Bestiary**: Detailed codex entries classifying entities by danger level, archetype, physical characteristics, and ancient survival taboos.
- **Bilingual Interface**: Full localization support in Thai and English.
- **Real-time Live Presence**: Anonymous live explorer count.
